headline: Indian markets stay under pressure amid volatile crude oil prices and US Federal Reserve policy uncertainty.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Elevated crude oil prices hovering around $113 to $115 per barrel weighing on market sentiment.
Widespread selling pressure in IT and Oil & Gas sector stocks dragging down benchmark indices.
Uncertainty over the US Federal Reserve's rate path after holding interest rates steady.
Concerns over slowing corporate profit growth due to rising input and operational costs.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty faced sharp declines as IT stock sell-offs and energy costs exerted downward pressure.
Crude oil prices dipped slightly to $113 per barrel amid diplomatic talks offsetting supply fears.
The US Fed held interest rates unchanged, keeping global bond and stock markets cautious.
Major domestic companies including Bajaj Auto and Cipla announced their Q2 FY27 earnings results.
summary: Indian benchmark indices fell due to rising crude oil prices and heavy selling in IT stocks. The US Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, creating a cautious outlook across global markets. Meanwhile, Bajaj Auto and Cipla declared their Q2 FY27 financial results.
